findings.reason: without a per-dialect membership fact the interim record either reports one of its five arms empty or quietly applies a rule the authority does not state, and both outcomes make the codex-anchored column unreadable to §8.
findings.text: §12 says "Run membership in an anchored arm follows section 8's rule: the anchored server reads connected at session start and the run launched after section 10 landed", but that session-start status is a Claude Code stream record and a codex run emits none: the recorded codex prototype stream (`docs/research/fixtures/codex-anchored-edit-stream.jsonl`) holds only `thread.started`, `turn.started`, `item.started`/`item.completed` and `turn.completed`, with no `mcp_servers` status anywhere, so every codex anchored run evaluates as not-in-arm and the wave's four codex-anchored runs populate no arm; the plan is also internally split here, since §5 states the codex membership condition is the launch having applied the anchored `-c` overrides and that such a run "records `true` and is not folded into the baseline arm"

findings.reason: the record's only stated rule for calling something "within noise" is decided by a coin flip, so the interim report can flag a spurious difference on the very population §8's verdict later inherits.
findings.text: the negative control defines the noise floor as the difference between two parity halves of the baseline local arm's ~4 runs and then treats any larger arm difference as a difference, but that split difference is one draw of a variable with expectation zero, so the threshold it sets is arbitrary rather than calibrated: a split that lands close (the common case) sets a floor near zero and passes normal variance through as an arm difference, while the section's own admission that "at two runs per pseudo-arm a percentile interval of the mean is the pair's own range" applies equally to the point difference it substitutes

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the fragments directory and every fixture the controls depend on exist in the tree (`codex-anchored-edit-stream.jsonl`, `codex-refused-patch-stream.jsonl`), and the inline §8 and §10 references resolve to sections that are present.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §12's negative control at line 125 states a one-sided rule, "any arm's difference from the baseline no larger than [the floor] is stated as within noise, not as a difference", which says nothing about a difference larger than the floor and so licenses one to be reported as a difference, while the floor itself is a single parity draw of two runs against two and therefore has expectation zero and wide spread; a floor that lands at a few percent converts ordinary section-to-section variance into an apparent arm difference in the record §8 later builds on.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the record is named at `docs/evidence/fragments/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node/interim-arm-report.html`, an existing durable directory under the repository, and the section names no scratchpad or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §12 introduces no symbol, filename or comment carrying a plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §12 imports §8's anchored-arm membership rule verbatim, "the anchored server reads connected at session start", but a codex run's stream carries no session-start MCP status record, so the rule cannot be evaluated for the codex anchored arm and the only codex membership fact available is the launch record's `anchored_edit`, which §5 states is the right one for codex.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §12 delivers one artifact, the interim evidence record; the coordinator's routing of the wave is stated as the coordinator's action, not the node's second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §12 needs only §4, §5, §7 (all done, and the arms they build), §10 (done, and named in the section's own membership sentence) and §9 (done); the ~20-run wave it asks the coordinator to route has no live upstream left, and an edge to §8 would deadlock it since §8's node is gated on 30/15 runs per arm that §12's own Why says do not yet exist.
